title: Updating one unary tape
statement: Let $v$ assign a natural number to each of three tape indices, and let $t$ be one of those indices and $m$ a natural number. Replacing tape $t$ by the unary tape of length $m$ in the family of tapes determined by $v$ gives exactly the family determined by replacing $v(t)$ with $m$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $v$ assigns a natural number to each of three tape indices.
The selected tape index $t$ is one of the three indices.
The replacement length $m$ is a natural number.
